Company Profile

Built on Precision,
Trusted by Developers

Since 2019, Elshal Factory has set the benchmark for aluminum inspection covers in Egypt. Located in the Biyad Elarab Industrial Area, Benisuef, our facility combines modern fabrication with strict HBRC-compliant quality standards.

Our covers protect drainage and electrical infrastructure — trusted by Egypt's leading developers from New Cairo to Mostakbal City.

Technical Excellence

Why Engineers
Specify Elshal

Every design decision is grounded in engineering. Our covers meet and exceed the Housing & Building Research Center standards that Egyptian projects demand.

5
Ton Load Capacity

HBRC lab-tested to withstand ultimate loads up to 10 tons. Suitable for vehicular traffic, heavy machinery, and high-footfall commercial zones.

HBRC LOAD TEST — CI 987 / 988 / 990 / 991
01
HBRC Certification

Fully compliant with ES 4207/3 (2020) — the standard specified on all Egyptian construction projects.

REPORTS 2023/2398 · 2401 · 2403 · 2404
02
Triple Rubber Gasket Seal

Three-layer seal eliminates odor, water, and dust ingress — critical for drainage covers in occupied residential and commercial spaces.

03
Grade 304 Stainless Steel

All fasteners and handle hardware use SS Grade 304 — fully corrosion-resistant across the 10+ year product lifespan.

04
Alloy 6063 — Certified Source

Sourced from Misr Aluminum and Delmar Aluminum Profiles. Full supply chain traceability from billet to finished cover.
